reasons: Section 28.1 selects New York law and 28.2 grants exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County — exactly the GOVLAW preferred position.
No arbitration provision (and no foreign seat) appears, so no walk-away risk; the mutual injunctive-relief carve-out and executive escalation do not displace the agreed forum.
Correctly reported as compliant with no redline and no counterparty comment, consistent with expectations for a compliant finding; deterministic check on accepted jurisdiction passes.
